dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rjkv](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rjkv) Magnitude 6.2 earthquake at 95.551 depth occurred on Oct 26 2025 30km NW of Citrana. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -9.0988 longitude 123.9517. It impacted 89918 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
